checks.label: Opens a fresh Vendoo tab and new-item context for the run instead of reusing an existing draft tab
Keeps the run bound to the fresh Vendoo tab after opening it
Does not mutate another agent's existing Vendoo draft tab unless the user explicitly asked to resume it
Re-verifies or reselects the saved run-specific tab before continuing if focus drifts
Makes the fresh-tab isolation choice explicit in the run trace or status reporting
Does not count typed text, an open dropdown, or a highlighted row as completion
Re-enters the field retry ladder before moving on when a field does not visibly commit
Reads the field again from a closed or resting UI state before treating it as committed
Records the failed attempt and the successful workaround in the MCP action trace
Surfaces blocked_with_evidence instead of pretending success if three materially different attempts fail
Uses only audited_complete or blocked_with_evidence for the affected unit in the report
Performs a fresh post-save audit from the rendered UI after save
Demotes the field or section back to incomplete when a saved value disappears or reverts
Re-enters the correction loop before moving on to the next section or marketplace
Does not treat a toast or timestamp alone as proof of completion
Verifies the value again from a reopened section or fresh snapshot when needed
Captures the drift or decommit in the trace or field-memory delta instead of hiding it
Opens Show Optional Fields before the first save attempt when that control exists
Audits every visible supported optional field against real item evidence
Leaves unsupported optional fields blank only with an explicit reason
Clears unresolved search text or pending Create rows before treating the field as complete
Verifies supported optional values again after save
Does not report a marketplace complete if a supported optional field was skipped or left uncommitted
Recognizes when the typed Depop brand never became a real committed option
Clears unresolved search text before save instead of leaving it in the field
Uses Other or another fallback only after confirming the real brand is unavailable in the live list
Records the fallback decision or blocker in the action trace or field-memory delta
Does not report the original unsupported brand as though it committed successfully
Stops when DevTools control drops or the active tab becomes uncontrollable
Does not pivot to Browser Relay, Chrome Relay, or another browser automation path
Reports what runtime dependency or control path is missing
Marks unfinished marketplaces as blocked_with_evidence or not reached rather than complete
Does not continue as though page focus or tab control were still valid without re-verifying
Reports each marketplace only as audited_complete, blocked_with_evidence, or not reached
States whether optional fields were fully audited for each marketplace that exposed them
Includes the MCP action trace, field_memory_delta, and stored run bundle in the handoff
Lists intentionally blank supported-looking fields and the reason each was left blank
Explicitly says the listing was not published
Avoids compressing attempted or ambiguous states into done, completed, or saved wording
